items.source:
Retrieves documents by query embedding similarity and matching the filters. Value of 'null' means that no metadata filters will be applied to the search. For example if the Document.getMetadata() schema is: 
{
"country": <Text>,
"city": <Text>,
"year": <Number>,
"price": <Decimal>,
"isActive": <Boolean>
}
you can constrain the search result to only UK countries with isActive=true and year equal or greater 2020. You can build this such metadata filter programmatically like this: 
var exp = new Filter.Expression(AND,
		new Expression(EQ, new Key("country"), new Value("UK")),
		new Expression(AND,
				new Expression(GTE, new Key("year"), new Value(2020)),
				new Expression(EQ, new Key("isActive"), new Value(true))));
The Filter.Expression is portable across all vector stores.
The FilterExpressionBuilder is a DSL creating expressions programmatically: 
var b = new FilterExpressionBuilder();
var exp = b.and(
		b.eq("country", "UK"),
		b.and(
			b.gte("year", 2020),
			b.eq("isActive", true)));
The FilterExpressionTextParser converts textual, SQL like filter expression language into Filter.Expression: 
var parser = new FilterExpressionTextParser();
var exp = parser.parse("country == 'UK' && isActive == true && year >=2020");
items.translation:
通过查询嵌入相似性和匹配过滤器来检索文档。 “null”值表示搜索时不会应用任何元数据过滤器。 例如，如果 `Document.getMetadata()` 的架构如下： 
{
"country": <Text>,
"city": <Text>,
"year": <Number>,
"price": <Decimal>,
"isActive": <Boolean>
}
您可以将搜索结果限制为仅包含英国（UK）且 `isActive=true` 以及年份大于或等于 2020 的文档。您可以通过以下方式以编程方式构建此元数据过滤器： 
var exp = new Filter.Expression(AND,
		new Expression(EQ, new Key("country"), new Value("UK")),
		new Expression(AND,
				new Expression(GTE, new Key("year"), new Value(2020)),
				new Expression(EQ, new Key("isActive"), new Value(true))));
Filter.Expression 可在所有向量存储之间移植使用。
FilterExpressionBuilder 是一个用于以编程方式创建表达式的 DSL： 
var b = new FilterExpressionBuilder();
var exp = b.and(
		b.eq("country", "UK"),
		b.and(
			b.gte("year", 2020),
			b.eq("isActive", true)));
FilterExpressionTextParser 将文本形式的、类似 SQL 的过滤器表达式语言转换为 Filter.Expression： 
var parser = new FilterExpressionTextParser();
var exp = parser.parse("country == 'UK' && isActive == true && year >=2020");

items.source:
Document metadata filter expression. For example if your Document.getMetadata() has a schema like: 
{
"country": <Text>,
"city": <Text>,
"year": <Number>,
"price": <Decimal>,
"isActive": <Boolean>
}
then you can constrain the search result with metadata filter expressions like: 
country == 'UK' && year >= 2020 && isActive == true
Or
country == 'BG' && (city NOT IN ['Sofia', 'Plovdiv'] || price < 134.34)
This ensures that the response contains only embeddings that match the specified filer criteria.
The declarative, SQL like, filter syntax is portable across all vector stores supporting the filter search feature.
The FilterExpressionTextParser is used to convert the text filter expression into Filter.Expression.
items.translation:
文档元数据过滤表达式。例如，如果您的Document.getMetadata()具有如下模式： 
{
"country": <Text>,
"city": <Text>,
"year": <Number>,
"price": <Decimal>,
"isActive": <Boolean>
}
那么您可以使用元数据过滤表达式来限制搜索结果，例如： 
country == 'UK' && year >= 2020 && isActive == true
或
country == 'BG' && (city NOT IN ['Sofia', 'Plovdiv'] || price < 134.34)
这确保响应仅包含符合指定过滤条件的嵌入向量。
这种声明式、类似 SQL 的过滤语法可在所有支持过滤搜索功能的向量存储之间移植。
FilterExpressionTextParser用于将文本过滤表达式转换为Filter.Expression。

items.source: Retrieves documents by query embedding similarity and matching the filters.
items.translation: 通过查询嵌入相似度检索文档，并匹配过滤器。

items.source: Similarity threshold score to filter the search response by.
items.translation: 用于按相似度阈值过滤搜索结果的分数。

items.source:
Similarity threshold score to filter the search response by. Only documents
with similarity score equal or greater than the 'threshold' will be returned.
Note that this is a post-processing step performed on the client not the server
side. A threshold value of 0.0 means any similarity is accepted or disable the
similarity threshold filtering. A threshold value of 1.0 means an exact match
is required.
items.translation: 用于过滤搜索响应的相似度阈值分数。仅返回相似度分数大于或等于“threshold"的文档。请注意，这是在客户端而非服务端执行的后期处理步骤。阈值为 0.0 表示接受任何相似度或禁用相似度阈值过滤；阈值为 1.0 则表示需要精确匹配。

items.source: expression - Filter.Expression instance used to define the metadata filter criteria. The 'null' value stands for no expression filters.
items.translation: expression - 用于定义元数据过滤条件的 Filter.Expression 实例。'null' 值表示没有表达式过滤器。

items.source: query - Text to use for embedding similarity comparison.
items.translation: query - 用于嵌入相似度比较的文本。

items.source: topK - the top 'k' similar results to return.
threshold - The lower bound of the similarity score.
textExpression - declarative, portable, SQL like, metadata filter syntax. The 'null' value stands for no expression filters.
items.translation: textExpression - 声明式、可移植的、类似 SQL 的元数据过滤语法。 “null”值表示没有表达式过滤器。
